source_snippets: 4. Staff summary: This resolution is in recognition of the lifesaving efforts made by Storey County Fire District Firefighter Jesse Richardson. On July 26th Jesse responded along with his partner Charlie Bowman to a fire on Lousetown Road with a report of a victim trapped. While Charlie attempted access to the interior of the structure, Jesse carried a 24’ ladder around to the C side of the structure locating the victim on the balcony. He placed the ladder and even utilized a rock to stabilize it due to the angle. He then ascended the ladder and assisted the resident over the railing and down to safety. Without his efforts, the outcome could have been fatal.
